experiment_protocol.experiment: original-only versus original + horizontal RGB mirror
experiment_protocol.test_mix: Exactly one view per source; half mirrored within each letter/fold, fixed seed, shared by learners
experiment_protocol.paired_test: Also evaluate both views of every held-out source separately; never treat views as independent sources
experiment_protocol.training_sources: Freshly accepted originals only; add mirror only for these same fitting sources if accepted
experiment_protocol.weights: Original and mirror each .5 when both accepted; original alone 1 otherwise
experiment_protocol.preprocessing: Fit on original fitting rows only; preserve for both models
experiment_protocol.svm: C=10 RBF; gamma and balanced class weights taken from original fitting rows
experiment_protocol.lightgbm: 100 trees, 31 leaves, learning_rate .1, min_child_samples 20, seed 42, 4 threads
experiment_protocol.rejections: No prediction (?) for failed detection; all-attempt metrics include these failures
experiment_protocol.policy: One predefined mirror recipe; no tuning or candidate selection from held-out outcomes
experiment_protocol.scope: Synthetic mirroring robustness, not validated real left-handed signer performance

scope: Personal G/H view adaptation. Known back-of-hand examples are fitting data, not independent validation.

gh_view_adaptation.roll: 180 degrees around the vertical camera y axis: (dx,dy,dz) -> (-dx,dy,-dz); G/H only
gh_view_adaptation.roll_limit: Synthetic landmark rotation; no new visibility, occlusion or detector-error simulation
gh_view_adaptation.source_weight_policy: Kaggle originals/mirrors/rolls together retain total weight one per original source
gh_view_adaptation.calibration_role: All three are training; replay is not an independent test
gh_view_adaptation.calibration_permission: User explicitly requested reusing existing hand data for training; raw capture records are not changed
gh_view_adaptation.preprocessing: Reuse original-fit angle scaling and SVM gamma/class weights from the matched mirror baseline
gh_view_adaptation.evaluation: Same frozen source folds and random mix as mirror study; calibration sources are extra fitting data, never held-out evidence
gh_view_adaptation.selection: Axis correction requested by user after the index-axis development recipe; not selected by source-test score
